result.summary: The home screen has several visual and layout problems: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a loading spinner overlaying content, and a promo card that clips the last category.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge, and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Allow the horizontal list to scroll fully with peek padding, or wrap/scale names so the full title and card are visible.

issues.description: The cuisine filter chips overflow the screen; 'Healthy' is clipped and the next chip is only partially visible with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with enough end padding, or wrap chips so none are cut off.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner sits on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, covering the dish photo.
issues.suggestion: Use a skeleton or edge-aligned loader until the image is ready, then hide the spinner so the photo is fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cropped by the tab bar, so only the top of the dish and discount badge are visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so cards can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Notification badge on the bell icon is a small red dot without a count, and it sits tightly on the icon circle.
issues.suggestion: Add spacing or a numeric badge so the alert is clearer and not cramped.
